cases.invariant: A sensitivity break exists only in the memory of the test process and yields a complete record while the live files stay unchanged
cases.input: fixture governance contract with a critical case, a gate module, its selftest and a break spec that disables the gate's check; then a second spec for the same case
cases.response: no error; record with method in-memory, baseline passed, mutant failed, failureKind assertion, restored passed, break, breakSha256, artifact and artifactSha256; artifact with three TAP outputs; unchanged gate and test digests; the second run replaces the record
forbiddenEffects: a live gate or test file changed by a sensitivity run
cases.testName: [GOV-944-SENS-RUN-ALLOW] A sensitivity break exists only in the memory of the test process and yields a complete record while the live files stay unchanged

cases.invariant: Only a break that fails the named test with an assertion produces a record; every other break or spec is refused and writes nothing
cases.input: variants: a break the test does not detect; a line comment that swallows the rest of the line; find absent; find twice; replace equal to find; a target outside scope and inputs; the case test file as target; an unknown and a non-critical case; a spec outside the evidence tree; a product contract
cases.response: a named SENSITIVITY error per variant, exit 1, no artifact, no record and unchanged live digests
forbiddenEffects: a syntax or load error recorded as an assertion failure
a record written for a break that the test did not detect
cases.testName: [GOV-944-SENS-RUN-DENY] Only a break that fails the named test with an assertion produces a record; every other break or spec is refused and writes nothing

cases.invariant: A live file that changes during a sensitivity run, or a missing test file, ends the run with a named error and no record
cases.input: a fixture test that rewrites its gate file during the run; a contract whose case test file is missing
cases.response: SENSITIVITY: a live file changed during the run, and a named error for the missing file; no record; no exception
forbiddenEffects: a record made while the live tree changed
cases.testName: [GOV-944-SENS-LIVE-ERROR] A live file that changes during a sensitivity run, or a missing test file, ends the run with a named error and no record

cases.invariant: An in-memory record with a current break spec is accepted, and a legacy contract's record is validated as before
cases.actor: CI verify and the Stop gate
cases.input: a non-legacy fixture contract with an in-memory record and a current spec digest; a fixture contract whose task is the Task 941 kickoff name with a record without method
cases.response: no sensitivity error for either contract
cases.testName: [GOV-944-VAL-RECORD-ALLOW] An in-memory record with a current break spec is accepted, and a legacy contract's record is validated as before

cases.invariant: A non-legacy governance report refuses a critical sensitivity record that cli.mjs sensitivity did not make
cases.actor: Governance implementer writing a record by hand
cases.input: non-legacy fixture contract: a record without method; break outside the evidence tree; a stale breakSha256; a break spec of another case
cases.response: the named message sensitivity must come from cli.mjs sensitivity per variant, and governanceReport status failed
forbiddenEffects: a hand-written or live-edit record accepted as sensitivity proof
a passed governance report with such a record
cases.testName: [GOV-944-VAL-RECORD-DENY] A non-legacy governance report refuses a critical sensitivity record that cli.mjs sensitivity did not make

cases.invariant: An Edit or Write that would leave a hook-loaded module unparseable is refused for every role
cases.resource: evaluateHook PreToolUse and the hook-module closure
cases.input: fixture root whose settings run scripts/workflow-gates/hook.mjs importing ./lib.mjs: an Edit of lib.mjs with a line comment that swallows the rest of the line; a Write of unparseable text to hook.mjs; an Edit making a script named in a .claude/hooks ps1 file unparseable; an Edit with a two-line LF old_string that makes a CRLF lib.mjs unparseable; an Edit of hook.mjs importing a file not written yet; an Edit of lib.mjs removing an export hook.mjs imports; an Edit of lib.mjs adding a bare package import; orchestrator and executor sessions
cases.response: HOOK MODULE SYNTAX for each write
forbiddenEffects: a write that makes every hook refuse all tools
a session locked out of the Edit that would repair the module
cases.testName: [GOV-944-HOOK-SYNTAX-DENY] An Edit or Write that would leave a hook-loaded module unparseable is refused for every role

cases.invariant: A parseable write of a hook-loaded module, any write of a module no hook loads, and a repairing Edit are not refused by the syntax guard
cases.resource: evaluateHook PreToolUse and the hook-module closure
cases.input: a parseable Edit of lib.mjs; an unparseable Write to a .mjs that no hook loads; an Edit that repairs an unparseable closure module; a CommonJS .cjs closure module with require; a Write of new.mjs followed by an Edit of hook.mjs importing it; a fixture lib.mjs whose top level would write a marker file
cases.response: no HOOK MODULE SYNTAX error; no marker file, because no module is evaluated
forbiddenEffects: a valid edit of a gate module refused
a repair of a broken module refused
cases.testName: [GOV-944-HOOK-SYNTAX-ALLOW] A parseable write of a hook-loaded module, any write of a module no hook loads, and a repairing Edit are not refused by the syntax guard

cases.invariant: An unreadable closure input, an import cycle, an absent old_string or a failing guard step never throws out of evaluateHook
cases.resource: hookModuleSyntaxErrors, evaluateHook PreToolUse and the hook-module closure
cases.input: a fixture root without settings.json; a malformed settings.json; a root without a .claude/hooks folder; two closure modules importing each other; an Edit of a closure module whose old_string does not occur; an injected readText that throws
cases.response: no guard error and no exception for the first four; HOOK MODULE SYNTAX old_string not found for the absent old_string; HOOK MODULE SYNTAX guard error for the throwing reader, with no exception out of evaluateHook
forbiddenEffects: an exception that turns into SECURITY GATE BLOCKED for every tool
cases.testName: [GOV-944-HOOK-CLOSURE-ERROR] An unreadable closure input, an import cycle, an absent old_string or a failing guard step never throws out of evaluateHook

cases.invariant: A file changed by a shell compound command, a clustered nested-shell flag, an open or create call with a write mode, a pathlib or directory-delete call, a Windows or npm copy or delete tool, perl -i or env -C is counted as written
cases.input: revision 1 (owner D18): the R8 forms of the kickoff with X a fixture governance scope file and D its folder, each also as an executor event with X replaced by scripts/check-example.mjs; read controls through the same programs and APIs; revision 2: the require('fs').promises forms of R8 (f) and their read controls
cases.response: X among the targets and GOVERNANCE INDEPENDENCE for it; POLICY-EDIT AUTHORITY REQUIRED or SECURITY TEST CONTRACT MISSING for the executor forms; no X for the controls
forbiddenEffects: an implementing session approving a governance change it wrote through if/then, for/do, bash -lc, open(..., 'w') or a similar listed form
Sonnet changing a policy or product file through such a form without a refusal
cases.testName: [GOV-944-HOOK-SHELL-FORMS-DENY] A file changed by a shell compound command, a clustered nested-shell flag, an open or create call with a write mode, a pathlib or directory-delete call, a Windows or npm copy or delete tool, perl -i or env -C is counted as written
